snippet.title: Stop and Smell the Flowers Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Stop and Smell the Flowers is now on Steam to wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578290/Stop_and_Smell_the_Flowers/

You can also try the web demo here: https://iheartfunnyboys.itch.io/stop-and-smell-the-flowers

Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers. Plant flowers, earn money, expand your garden, and trace the evolution chart to complete your collection.
